Synopsis for the E Pacific within 250 nm of Mexico
919 AM PDT Thu Oct 15 2026

.SYNOPSIS...Hurricane Trudy is near 13.1N 101.6W at 8 AM PDT, 
and is moving north-northwest at 5 kt. Maximum sustained winds 
are 80 kt with gusts to 100 kt, and the minimum central pressure 
is 975 mb. Trudy will move to 13.6N 101.9W this evening, 14.6N 
102.2W Fri morning, and 15.5N 102.5W Fri evening. Hurricane
Trudy will be near 16.7N 103.4W Sat morning, 18.0N 104.3W Sat 
evening, and 19.4N 105.4W Sun morning. Trudy will weaken to a 
tropical storm west of Cabo Corrientes early Mon. Tropical Storm
Simon is near 19.2N 108.1W at 8 AM PDT, and is moving north at 0
kt. Maximum sustained winds are 50 kt with gusts to 60 kt, and 
the minimum central pressure is 996 mb. Simon will move to 19.5N 
108.1W this evening, 20.2N 108.8W Fri morning, and 21.1N 110.0W 
Fri evening. Tropical Storm Simon will be near 21.9N 111.3W Sat 
morning, then weaken to a tropical depression near 22.9N 112.6W 
Sat evening, and become a remnant low near 24.0N 113.6W Sun 
morning. The Remnant Low of Simon will just west of Baja 
California Sur early Mon. Gap winds in the Gulf of Tehuantepec my
reach gale force this weekend has high pressure builds southward
through Mexico in the wake of a cold front.
